paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend. The crown goes on Joshua's head, but the message points past him to another man. God says, 'Here is a man whose name is the Branch, and He will branch out from His place and build the temple of the LORD.' (Zechariah 6:12) Joshua gets the crown, and the Branch gets the work.

Now watch what this Branch is. He will be "clothed in splendor and will sit on His throne and rule." (Zechariah 6:13) And He will be a priest on His throne, with "peaceful counsel between the two." (Zechariah 6:13) A ruler and a priest, working together in peace, friend. I can barely get my apron strings and my mustache to cooperate!

And then there's that IF at the end. Even those far away will come and build, and the message says it will happen "if you diligently obey the voice of the LORD your God." (Zechariah 6:15) So the big idea for you is simple: God's plans are big and sure, and He invites you to listen and obey as part of them. Keep your ears open, baker, and keep those ovens ready!
